headline: China Third-Quarter GDP Grows 4.6% as Real Estate Investment Slumps
summary: China reported 4.5% acceleration in third-quarter economic growth, bringing the year-to-date expansion through September to 4.6%, even as real-estate-development investment dropped 20.6%.
why: As the world's second-largest economy, China's growth trajectory and real estate sector health heavily influence global commodity demand, trade flows, and emerging market sentiment.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Headline GDP growth met targets, but a steep contraction in real estate investment underscores persistent domestic property sector weakness.

why_moved: Official growth metrics and ongoing property sector contractions drive shifting expectations regarding Beijing's future economic stimulus measures and global commodity demand.
